sentences.text:
Jishan Sk. @ Kishan @ Sk. Nadim Hossain vs The State Of West
Bengal & Anr on 1 December, 2025

Author: Tirthankar Ghosh
Bench: Tirthankar Ghosh
 M/L 62 C.R.M. (Db) 1107 of 2025
01.12.2025
Bpg.

In Re: An application for bail under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Dismissed Procedure
corresponding to Section 483 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 filed in connection with
Sankrail Police Station Case No.1204 of 2021 dated 04.10.2021 under Section 376(2)(n) of the
Indian Penal Code and Section 6 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012;
Jishan sk. @ Kishan @ Sk. Nadim Hossain Versus The State of West Bengal & Anr.
Mr. Soumya Basu Roychowdhury.
...for the petitioner.
Ms. Baisali Basu Ms. Suveni Banerjee.

Learned advocate appearing for the State submits that the final arguments of the case are fixed on
9th December, 2025.
Having considered that the case has reached at the final stage of arguments, I am not inclined to release the petitioner on bail at this belated stage.
Petitioner would be at liberty to take up all his points at the time of arguments which are at the final stage.
All parties shall act on the server copy of this order duly downloaded from the official website of this Court.
Urgent photostat certified copy of this order, if applied for, be supplied to the parties upon compliance of all requisite formalities.

(Tirthankar Ghosh, J.)
